How it works

Every pet is tied to a real stock with real prices. No real money involved, ever.

1

Adopt a stock

Search 518 real stocks, including the S&P 500. Your buy-in price locks the moment you adopt.

2

Watch it grow

As your stock climbs, your pet evolves through 5 hand-drawn stages and earns you StockCoins.

3

Don't let it crash

If the stock falls, your pet gets sick. Let it fall 50% and it's off to the graveyard.

Learn the market by playing

StockPet is a game, but you'll walk away understanding how stocks actually move.

The StockPet Times · Word of the Day
Volatility

How wildly a price swings up and down. A new market word every day, explained simply.

Market Calls

Guess up or down for each pet before the market opens. Get it right and you earn StockCoins.

The S&P 500

Face the market each week and see how often one stock really beats the whole market.

Leverage

Try 2x and 4x pets that grow faster and fall faster, and learn why leverage is risky without risking a cent.

Price Targets

Predict where a stock will close and see how hard it really is to time the market.

Market Bubbles

Protect a pet for a few days and learn when it's worth playing it safe.

The weekend paper

Every Saturday a newspaper lands with how your pets did that week, next to the whole market.

Play with friends

Add friends with a code and battle your pets for the week, best gain wins. Send letters and StockCoins, visit each other's graveyards, and leave flowers when someone's portfolio needs thoughts and prayers.

Every pet gets a memorial

When a stock falls 50%, its pet is buried in the graveyard with a hand-drawn stone and its own obituary in the paper. Friends can leave flowers. It's not a bug. It's a feature.

"Rule No. 1: Never lose money. Rule No. 2: Never forget rule No. 1." — Warren Buffett
